jobs.title: Warehouse Operations Associate
jobs.summary: Support pick, pack, and dispatch operations at our Globeflight-powered fulfillment hub.
jobs.description:
You will pick and pack orders, zone parcels for Globeflight riders, and keep warehouse bays accurate. The role suits someone who enjoys physical work, checklists, and a busy Nairobi hub. Training is provided on our WMS, safety, and packing standards.

Typical day: receive pick lists, locate SKUs, pack to quality rules, and hand over to dispatch. You will also help with cycle counts and low-stock flags.

We look for reliability, basic computer literacy, and a customer-first attitude. Night and weekend rotations may apply.

jobs.title: Vendor Success Manager
jobs.summary: Onboard and support marketplace vendors — from first listing to sustained sales growth.
jobs.description:
Own the vendor journey from application to first live SKUs. You will train sellers on the dashboard, listing quality, stock alerts, and payouts, and escalate issues with operations.

You will run onboarding calls, review listing photos and descriptions, and help vendors grow through promotions and category advice.

Ideal background: account management, retail, or marketplace ops in Kenya. Clear written English and comfort with CRM tools required.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.summary: Help shoppers and vendors with orders, tracking, and account questions — 24/7 rotation.
jobs.description:
Answer shopper and vendor questions on orders, tracking, returns, and accounts across email, chat, and phone. You will update tickets, coordinate with Globeflight on delays, and keep a calm, accurate tone.

Shifts cover evenings and weekends. We measure first-response time, resolution quality, and CSAT.

Apply if you have contact-centre experience, excellent Kiswahili and English, and enjoy solving delivery puzzles.

items.q: What does BigDrop actually do for vendors?
items.a: BigDrop, powered by Globeflight Kenya, stores your inventory at our NextGen Mall warehouse, picks and packs every order, and delivers it nationwide — so you can focus on selling instead of logistics.

items.q: How do I send stock to your warehouse?
items.a: Drop off inventory at our NextGen Mall hub on Mombasa Road, or arrange a collection with our team. Once received, your stock is logged into our system with SKU-level visibility.

items.q: Can I check my stock levels at any time?
items.a: Yes. Your vendor dashboard shows live stock counts, low-stock alerts, and order history for every product you list.
Individual Facebook, Instagram and TikTok sellers, small businesses, and large enterprises are all welcome. Every vendor account requires admin approval before products can go live.

items.q: How long does vendor approval take?
items.a: Our team reviews new vendor applications promptly — usually within one business day. You will be notified once your store is approved and you can start listing products.

items.q: Do I need my own website to sell on BigDrop?
items.a: No. BigDrop gives you a marketplace storefront immediately. You can also link your existing social media pages to drive traffic to your BigDrop listings.
New vendors get hands-on training on our backend ERP dashboard, with a dedicated onboarding expert to guide your first listings and orders.
Once picked and packed, orders are handed to Globeflight riders for nationwide door-to-door delivery. A rider will call you ahead of drop-off.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: Use your order number or Globeflight tracking number on our Track page to see live status — from picking to out-for-delivery to confirmed delivery.
Delivery fees are shown at checkout. Pickup at NextGen Mall, 3rd Floor, Suite 40 is free.
Pay with M-Pesa at checkout. Card is coming soon. Cash on delivery is only available if BigDrop turns it on.

items.q: Can I shop on BigDrop for family in Kenya from abroad?
items.a: Yes. BigDrop is built for exactly this — order online from anywhere in the world and have it delivered to your family or friends anywhere in Kenya, with tracking every step of the way.

items.q: Can I pay from outside Kenya?
items.a: Pay with M-Pesa if you have a Kenyan line. Card checkout is coming soon.

items.q: Will the recipient be updated on delivery?
items.a: Yes — the recipient’s phone number can be added to shipping details so our rider can call ahead and confirm the delivery in person.
